correctness.rationale: The displayed 11-word code has pairwise disjoint one-deletion shadows. Independently, a complete maximum-clique search on the 81-word compatibility graph returned maximum 11. The symbolic upper-bound route is also coherent: the Kim–Lee–Oh normalized count gives at most 12 at q=3; equality would force one C_{4,2} word for each outer repeated symbol, but the two orientations per symbol produce only eight triples and every one has a deletion-output collision. Therefore 12 is impossible.
risks: The symbolic normalization relies on a published classification, but the independent complete 81-vertex search removes dependence on that premise for this finite parameter.
